title: Partial-response recovery and JSON-schema fallback regression tests
creator: Rafael Ortiz
description: Add a focused regression harness that verifies client-visible behavior when streaming responses are cut short, partially-delivered JSON chunks arrive, or model/transport glitches require automatic JSON-schema fallback paths. This ticket covers: 1) deterministic golden prompts that exercise partial-chunk boundaries; 2) fault-injection scenarios for truncated frames and reordered fragments; 3) verification that the server-side compatibility layer emits well-defined fallback events (ndjson fallback, structured error tokens) and triggers correct client-side reassembly guidance; 4) CI gating rules and flaky-test thresholds to minimize false positives while protecting API compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: A set of 120 golden prompts covering short, mid, and long sequences across 6 popular model variants (quantized and FP16) exists and is checked into canonical/gold_prompts/partial_recovery
Fault injector can produce: truncated chunk, duplicate chunk, reordered chunk, and KV-cache-miss-at-boundary for streaming endpoints

Regression harness asserts that: when partial JSON is received, server emits a single fallback marker event and the final output conforms to the agreed fallback schema (event.type in ["ndjson_fallback", "structured_error"])
CI job 'partial-json-recovery' runs on every runtime and streaming compatibility PR and fails only when the observed divergence exceeds 2% of golden baseline across stable models
Playbook entries added to docs/incident-playbooks with steps to reproduce locally, triage flaky failures, and backfill failing prompts into the golden corpus
tasks: Design golden-prompt matrix (prompt shapes, sequence lengths, tool-call interleaving) - Rafael to own matrix
Implement streaming fault-injector harness (go + python wrappers) - Maya to implement
Add schema fallback checker that validates fallback events and NDJSON reassembly rules
Run initial baseline across prod-like infra and collect stability metrics
Add CI pipeline with calibrated thresholds and an automatic triage labeler for flaky runs
Write playbook and link relevant dashboards in Console
